How to use these guides

Each guide is written to answer one question and then get out of the way: the numbers come first, the tables second, and any explanation after that. If a value contradicts what you see in-game, check your game version first — a patch that changed a recipe will not match an older guide. The site keeps its data in one place, so a fix propagates to the guide, the calculator and the ranking pages at the same time.
